newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN MOVING UP MARGINALLY.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN MOVING UP MARGINALLY.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to rise marginally for a third straight session on selective buying, brokers said.
"Some blue chip shares in engineering, cement and pharmaceuticals sectors might gain slightly," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
"Market sentiment is still weak. Retailers are still in a watching mood," he said.
The DSE all-share price index gained 1.75 points or 0.18 percent to 954.89 on turnover of 50 million taka on Monday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-869749
